description: Repairs r-lock-3-4-txn/write-ddl-vs-open-transaction: a's own ALTER TABLE and CREATE INDEX after its insert into U in its own transaction returned 3211 before b ran, so no catalog change existed to be rolled back. Process a begins a transaction and FIRST adds a column Za and creates an index IX_Ua on U, then inserts a row into U (DBEngine.Errors after each). Process b, with DBEngine.Errors right before and after each, tries ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN, CREATE INDEX and DROP TABLE on U, then reads U's field names (after a TableDefs and Fields Refresh) and rows. Process a rolls back and reads U's field names; b reads field names and rows again and tries ADD COLUMN once more.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
